auto_open.message: Automatically open the folder when you hover the mouse pointer.

auto_open_pause.message: Pause before automatically opening the folder (in milliseconds: 1 s = 1000 ms):

description.message: Add a button to popup your bookmarks.

open_wo_closing.message: Open tab without closing popup: Middle-click bookmark.

style_textarea.message: Set custom CSS style for the popup menu

update_favicon.message: Refresh a favicon: right-click the bookmark (only when favicon loading is enabled).

theme_hint.message: Automatic follows the Firefox/system light or dark preference. Custom CSS is preserved.

holiday_dates.message: Halloween: October 25–November 1 · Christmas: December 20–26 · New Year: December 27–January 3. Your regular theme applies outside these dates.

holiday_active.message: Currently active: {theme}. Your regular theme returns automatically afterwards.

pin_to_toolbar.message: Show the toolbar button: open the Firefox extensions (puzzle) menu → three dots beside the add-on → Pin to Toolbar.

favicon_hint.message: If enabled, bookmark favicons may be loaded directly from their HTTPS websites. You can grant additional permissions to find more real icons. These websites and their icon hosts may see the requests. No external favicon proxy or analytics.

favicon_enabled.message: Favicons enabled. Reopen the bookmarks popup to fetch icons.

favicon_denied.message: Permission not granted. Favicons remain disabled.

favicon_disabled.message: Favicons disabled. No remote icons are requested.

favicon_enhanced_button.message: Find more real favicons: grant access

favicon_enhanced_hint.message: Optional: Firefox requests access to websites and open tabs, used only to detect favicon URLs. Page HTML is fetched without cookies; bookmark URLs are never sent to a central collection server.

favicon_enhanced_active.message: Enhanced favicon detection is active. Reopen your bookmarks.

favicon_enhanced_inactive.message: Enhanced detection is not enabled yet.

favicon_enhanced_denied.message: Permission was declined. Basic favicon detection remains available.
